ProxyEnv Switch 1.1.0 for Windows 11
====================================

ProxyEnvSwitch_x64.exe
  Use on most Intel or AMD 64-bit Windows 11 computers.

ProxyEnvSwitch_ARM64.exe
  Use on Windows 11 ARM computers.

The application sets or removes the current user's persistent HTTP_PROXY and
HTTPS_PROXY variables. Administrator rights are not required.

Enter a local proxy port such as 60505 and select Add / Update Proxy or Remove
Proxy. Reopen existing terminals and applications after changing the values.

The revised interface is DPI-aware and resizable so text remains visible at
higher Windows display scaling.
